_comment: Partner-vendor model IDs on cloud platforms, by vendor family, not by model. Provider ids are the ones the feed uses for that vendor (feed src/clouds.ts vendorProvider), so a model found here matches the platform's retirement records. A model recognised only through this file counts only where the code runs it on that platform: Bedrock IDs say so themselves; an Azure family name needs the code to place it on Azure (src/scan/platform.ts). test/partner-models.test.ts checks every Azure and Bedrock model ID in the feed against this file.

bedrock._comment: A Bedrock model ID is <namespace>.<model>, with an optional cross-region prefix (us., eu., global. …) or a bedrock ARN in front. namespaces: the ID's namespace → the feed's provider id. A strong ID (ends in a Bedrock version such as -v1:0, or has a region prefix or ARN) counts anywhere; one without counts only in Bedrock code.

azure._comment: Model names in Azure's model catalog, per vendor family (case-insensitive, whole name). Only counted where the code runs the model on Azure.
